item.title: LycanForge Add-On v1.2.0
item.creator: JWolf Creations
item.description:
Transform into a werewolf in any world! Craft the Lycan Forge to unlock fierce abilities - claw attacks, night vision, wall-climbing, and powerful howls.

- Progression-based skill unlocks
- Survival and Multiplayer friendly
- Compatible with custom player animations
- Endlessly Customizable: Create your unique werewolf with over 2 million appearance combinations!
item.changelog:
- Added new werewolf coat colors
- Added new werewolf skills
- Added new equipment
- Quality of life changes
- and lots more! Open the Guide Book and navigate to [About] -> [Changelog] for details.

faqEntries.heading: How does transforming work?
faqEntries.content: When you first become a werewolf, you will transform into werewolf form at night in the Overworld. As you unlock more skills, you'll be able to stay in werewolf form during the day if you want.

faqEntries.heading: What kinds of special traits do werewolves have?
faqEntries.content: Werewolves have higher agility, increased strength, and regeneration. You can also learn special skills for things like claw attacks, wall climbing, entity tracking, super jumping, and more!

faqEntries.heading: Is there a progression system?
faqEntries.content: Yes. When you become a werewolf, you start off with very few abilities. You can spend resources and XP to earn new skills and get stronger!

faqEntries.heading: Does this work in multiplayer?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Multiple players can be werewolves. This add-on is designed to be multiplayer compatible.

faqEntries.heading: Do all players have to be werewolves or select a class?
faqEntries.content: No, players that don't want to be a werewolf can keep their gameplay totally unchanged.

faqEntries.heading: Can a player become a werewolf hunter?
faqEntries.content: Yes, if that's your thing. This add-on also includes special equipment that players can use to defend & fight against a werewolf.

howToEntries.heading: Quickstart: How to Become a Werewolf
howToEntries.content:
1. Head to a Taiga forest
2. Harvest either a Moonglow Sprig or a Zephyrstone Cluster
3. Combine it with 4 cobblestone to make a Werewolf Emblem
4. Activate the emblem to unlock your werewolf form!
Check the Guide Book for more details!
